{{Quote|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders broke through the Republic lines and invaded Taris; skirted the Republic border to attack Ithor, Ord Mantell, and the Zabrak worlds around Iridonia: blasted the border world of Eres III.|From Vilnau Teupt's "Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul," 24 ABY|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], the two factions '''battled''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] launched their full invasion of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]], splitting into three invasion corridors. One group [[Battle of the Zongorlu system|charged through]] the [[Zongorlu system/Legends|Zongorlu system]] to Ord Mantell, where the Mandalorians triumphed before moving to [[First battle of Iridonia (Mandalorian Wars)|conquer]] the planet of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].

==Prelude==
In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] launched their full invasion of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] after harassing it for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in the early stages of a conflict called the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. They began by [[Taris Siege|conquering]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] before advancing their forces to carve three paths through Republic territory. One path took [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] through the [[Zongorlu system/Legends|Zongorlu system]], where they won a [[Battle of the Zongorlu system|battle]], and that group split between those that would [[Battle of Ithor (Mandalorian Wars)|attack]]<ref name="Atlas" /> an [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] world,<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="Warfare" /> and those that moved to assault<ref name="Atlas" /> the planet of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], one of the Republic's [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Mandalorians [[Attacks on the Zabrak colonies|harassed and conquered]] the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colonies in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> at this [[Time/Legends|time]] as well.<ref name="Warfare" />

==The battle==
The battle on Ord Mantell was one of many the Mandalorians won during their invasion.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Aftermath==
Following Ord Mantell, the Mandalorians moved on to [[First battle of Iridonia (Mandalorian Wars)|take]] the planet of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].<ref name="Atlas" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vilnau Teupt]] mentioned the battle at Ord Mantell in an overview of the Mandalorian Wars during his delivery of the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] at the 412th [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]], in which he spoke on the Mandalorian race's development.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It was marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the course of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose. In the ''Atlas'', the Bright Jewel system was denoted as the "Ord Mantell system"<ref name="Atlas" /> after the planet of Ord Mantell, which it contained.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The battle was later mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which established that it took place on the planet itself.<ref name="Warfare" />
